verdict.rationale: SIP bridging is a fair question for a realtime media relay, since realtime media platforms can plausibly offer telephony ingress, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only MoQ relay creation, token-scoped publish/subscribe auth, QUIC-based streaming and draft-version interop testing. Nothing mentions SIP, trunking or interoperability with any telephony carrier.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier
